title: DPIARequirementDetermination
description: PACK-09, Framework 0.8.1 section 13.1. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.dataprotection.DPIARequirementDetermination). Recorded even when `dpia_required` is false, because the ABSENCE of a determination is what blocks activation: 'nobody ever asked' and 'we asked and the answer was no' are different states with different outcomes. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
